$schema-note: Frozen parity corpus for WritingRuleEngine.cs (.NET, sole runtime since R-a retired the TS engine). Expected sets use BUILTIN.<checkId> ids (renamed from R-ids when canonical content dropped checkIds). Asserted by backend/tests/OetLearner.Api.Tests/Rulebook/WritingEngineParityTests.cs. R12.3 was dropped (no current rule forbids smoker/drinker labels). BUILTIN.signoff_no_invented_name is expected on all five fixtures: the battery supports a detector the retired JSON lacked, and every fixture signs 'Dr A B' with no case-notes writer name. 2026-09-09: dropped BUILTIN.letter_structure_order from all five fixtures. Root cause: ParseLetter's date regex only matched 'day month' with no year, so every fixture's '1 January 2026' header (the Addendum's own lead date example) never set DateIndex, producing a false 'missing Date' finding that this retired-engine snapshot had frozen in unnoticed. Not a governed rulebook change — the date-format rules (R.2.2 in the Global Formatting Addendum) already required 'D Month YYYY' to be a recognised style; the parser was simply wrong. Fixed in WritingRuleEngine.ParseLetter; see ParseLetter_RecognisesEveryAddendumDateStyle_AsTheDateLine in RulebookEngineTests.cs for the regression coverage. Every other expected id is unchanged (confirmed via full assertion diff — the fix touches only date-line detection, nothing else). 2026-09-11 (owner Writing Addendum Rev8 detectors, candidate mode): added BUILTIN.judgmental_labels to A, C and D ('is a non-smoker' is a person label again, superseding the R12.3 drop above); BUILTIN.body_forbidden_phrase_the_patient to C ('The patient ...', OWN-W-009 supersedes G-W-112); BUILTIN.closure_contact_offer to C (closure 'Please see him ASAP. I would appreciate your specialist review.' conveys no contact offer, OWN-W-014); BUILTIN.date_format_consistent to D (the two-digit-year slash date "01/01/'25" is now classified, so it mixes with the written '1 January 2026' header). B and E are unchanged; every other Rev8 detector was traced against all five letters and returns nothing.
